100 / 100S3: Cortech Solstice Bed
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-100-100s3-solstice-behavioral-health-bed
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/beds/solstice-bed/
Spec sheet: 100
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Solstice Bed – 100 / 100S3
Current H1: Cortech Solstice - Behavioral Health Bed - One‑Piece Rotationally Molded Design - Models 100 / 100S3
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded Bed with Raised Head and Footboards for a 36”×75” Mattress, with Optional Ballast Doors
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 100 / 100S3 Solstice Bed for Behavioral Healthcare Facilities
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Solstice Bed is a one-piece molded bed with a home-like look for patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals. Raised, molded-in head and footboards keep the mattress from sliding, and the bed fits a 36”×75” mattress.
The bed is rotationally molded as a single unit from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no seams, steel, or wood. It can be bolted to the floor through concealed pilot holes, or the 100S3 can be weighted with sandbags through underside ballast doors.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Dimensions: 80”L×36”W×21”H
Weight: 120 lbs
Mattress: Fits a 36”×75” mattress (sold separately)
Head and Footboards: Molded-in, raised head and footboards keep the mattress from sliding
Storage: No shelves or storage
Ballast Doors: The 100S3 has underside ballast doors for adding sandbags; do not use loose sand
Floor Mounting: Can be bolted to the floor through concealed pilot holes
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD Gold
Easy Cleaning: Easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
100 – Standard: Without ballast doors
100S3 – With Ballast Doors: Underside ballast doors for adding sandbags
Installation and Options
Floor Mounting: Bolt to the floor through concealed pilot holes. Hardware not included
Ballast Doors: Add sandbags through the underside ballast doors on the 100S3; do not use loose sand. Hardware bit size is T27
[H2] Applications
The Solstice Bed suits patient rooms that need a safe, strong bed with a calm, residential look.
Typical applications include:
Patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers and other secure facilities
Cells and housing units in correctional facilities
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Patient Safety Beds and Bed Restraints collections for more beds and patient room furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Beds
Cortech beds are rotationally molded in one piece for patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and cells in correctional facilities, where beds must be safe, strong, and easy to clean.
Cortech beds include:
Solstice Series: The Solstice Bed, and the Solstice Safeguard Bed with raised side panels for fall-risk patients
Sequoia Series: Molded beds and night stands with a wood grain finish
Endurance Series: Endurance beds, wall mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (54 characters): Cortech Solstice Molded Bed - 100 / 100S3 at Anchortex
Meta description (149 characters): Shop the Cortech Solstice Bed. A one-piece molded bed with raised head and footboards for a 36”×75” mattress that bolts down or takes ballast weight.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Beds" is a new section for the Solstice and Sequoia bed pages. It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: Cortech calls it the Solstice Bed. I took out "Behavioral Health Bed," "One-Piece Rotationally Molded Design," and "Models."
Weight: your variant is set to 145 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 120 lbs, so I used 120 lbs.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year factory warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects, so I used that.
100S3: the Cortech spec sheet lists only the 100 and says the underside ballast doors are optional. It does not give a model number for the ballast door version, or say how many doors there are. I kept your 100S3 variant.
Colors: the Cortech spec sheet lists 18 colors on the first page and 12 on the second page. I used the 18.
I left out the noise test (RAL-AN23-010) and "Patent Pending," since the Cortech spec sheet does not say these.
Antimicrobial: "Tested to ISO 22196" comes from the Cortech web page. The spec sheet has a "Now infused with antimicrobial compound" badge.
Product images: the page has two images: an Aqua bed photo and an older chart with 12 color dots. The Cortech product page has photos of the Solstice Bed in all 18 colors. Would you like me to add them, and replace the chart with the 18-color chart?
